test_nest_flatten: test nest.flatten to recursively flatten nested tuples, lists, and dicts into a flat sequence
test_nest_map: test nest.map to apply a lambda function to all leaf elements in a nested structure
test_nest_pack_as: test nest.pack_as to reconstruct a nested structure from a flattened list of leaf values
test_nest_map_many2: test nest.map_many2 to apply a two-argument function across corresponding leaves of two nested structures
test_nest_for_each: test nest.for_each to visit every leaf element in a nested structure with a callback function
